_comment: Guided tour of the style manager.

steps.title: Styles are files you own
steps.text: The drop-down lists the .css style sheets in your ChiSurf settings directory. The shipped styles are copied there on first run, so editing one never touches the installation.

steps.title: What a style sheet says
steps.text: An emtk style sheet is a small CSS dialect. A rule names a control (button), a state (:hover) or a part (menu::item) and sets its colours; padding and border-radius set the spacing of every control.

steps.title: Apply, and it stays applied
steps.text: Apply saves the file, restyles the running application at once, and records it as your style so it comes back next time you start.

await.hint: Press Apply to see the style take effect.

steps.title: If you make a mess
steps.text: Reset styles restores the shipped files. And if a style leaves the window unreadable, delete that .css from your settings directory and restart — ChiSurf falls back to the default appearance.
